fail_closed_rule: Any missing, duplicate, contradictory, or differently linked target row stops Phase 9.
hard_pass_rule: Exactly one second-source row has fantasypros_id 26964.
Exactly one second-source row has sleeper_id 12412.
Those lookups resolve to the exact same row.
The common row name normalizes exactly to terrell jennings.
The common row position is RB.
The common row has a non-missing GSIS stable identifier.
The common row has a non-missing PFR stable identifier.
No other current manual-review identity is read or promoted.
